packageRules.description: docker-compose.yml images follow what runs on board (edge-flux, or the on-board Home Assistant), so we bump them by hand instead of tracking upstream
One PR for all non-major Rust crate updates, so they stop conflicting on the shared Cargo.lock files
Read the Python version from uv builder tags like python3.13-trixie-slim, so the builder moves with the runtime image
Move the Python version in Dockerfiles, workflows and requires-python together
